action.id: Biarkan satu rencana berubah tanpa kamu betulkan.
action.en: Let one plan change without correcting it.

action.id: Mulai satu hari minggu ini tanpa daftar apa pun.
action.en: Start one day this week with no list at all.

action.id: Pilih satu rutinitas dan jaga sampai akhir minggu.
action.en: Pick one routine and keep it all the way to the weekend.

action.id: Tulis 3 hal yg pasti terjadi besok, lalu tempel di kulkas.
action.en: Write the three things that will definitely happen tomorrow, and stick it on the fridge.

action.id: Kasih anakmu satu pilihan beneran hari ini — yg dua-duanya kamu terima.
action.en: Give your child one genuine choice today — one where you'd accept either answer.

action.id: Jelaskan satu aturan sekali, lalu berhenti menjelaskan.
action.en: Explain one rule once, then stop explaining it.

action.id: Tentukan satu batas dan pertahankan sampai selesai.
action.en: Set one limit and hold it to the end.

action.id: Sekali minggu ini, putuskan tanpa menawarkan pilihan.
action.en: Once this week, decide without offering a choice.

action.id: Setelah menamai perasaannya, diam 10 detik sebelum lanjut.
action.en: After you name the feeling, stay quiet for ten seconds before anything else.

action.id: Sekali aja, dengarkan sampai habis tanpa menawarkan solusi.
action.en: Just once, listen all the way to the end without offering a solution.

action.id: Sebelum membereskan masalahnya, sebut satu kata perasaan dulu.
action.en: Before you fix it, say one feeling word first.

action.id: Tanya sekali: "Mau dipeluk, atau mau sendiri dulu?"
action.en: Ask once: "Do you want a hug, or a minute first?"

action.id: Berhenti di percobaan pertama kalau dia bilang cukup.
action.en: Stop at the first try if they say that's enough.

action.id: Biarkan satu kegiatan selesai lebih cepat dr rencanamu.
action.en: Let one outing end earlier than you planned.

action.id: Biarkan satu hal kecil dicoba sendiri, walau hasilnya berantakan.
action.en: Let one small thing be attempted alone, mess included.
